'''''Star Wars: Droids''''' was a series of [[Star Wars comic books|comics]] revolving around [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] from [[1995]] to [[1997]] and succeeding an [[Star Wars: Droids (1994)|earlier series]] of the same name in [[1994]]. The logo for ''Star Wars: Droids'' was designed by [[Scott Tice]]. The [[Star Wars Publications Timeline|''Star Wars'' Publications Timeline]] in [[Star Wars Insider 23|''Star Wars Insider'' 23]] referred to the series as '''Droids II'''.
